caption:
It’s never been easier to create AI employees.

So we built 16 of them.

And they run my entire sales and marketing.

Here’s the thing most people get wrong:

They build one AI assistant.
Ask it to do everything.
Research. Writing. Outreach. Content. Strategy.

That’s like hiring one person to run your whole company.

It doesn’t work.

Here’s what does:

Specialists.

One agent that only researches prospects.
One that only writes cold emails.
One that only scrapes leads.
One that only analyzes viral content.
One that only generates hooks.

Each one is dumb. On purpose.

One job. Done extremely well.

But here’s where it gets interesting:

They talk to each other.

The researcher passes context to the email writer.
The scraper feeds the outreach agent.
The content analyzer feeds the hook generator.

Now it’s not 16 tools.

It’s a system.

Tools answer questions.
Systems run processes while you sleep.

Here’s my setup:

SALES (9 agents):
→ Research — prospects, accounts, competitors
→ Scraping — Google Maps, LinkedIn, lead magnets
→ Outreach — emails, DMs, local BDR

MARKETING (7 agents):
→ Analysis — Instagram reels, TikToks
→ Creation — ideation, writing, images
→ Distribution — repurposing everywhere

This isn’t about saving 10 minutes.

It’s about building infrastructure that compounds.

Want to try 2 of these agents yourself?

Comment “CREATE” and I’ll send you free access 👇
